title: AIArchive — model preservation news
description: Captures, mirrors, takedown alerts and radar signals for open-weight AI models

items.title: This week aiarchive.info captured two new open-weight models: internlm/AdvancedMathBench-AutoVerifier and BAAI/AREX-2. No models were mirrored and no alerts were issued. Radar picked up new papers referencing DeepSeek (including work on sparse MoE load balancing and multi-agent oversight) and Qwen (including a benchmark for spatial context retrieval in open-weight LLMs).
